items.q: Robert came in with a song... we went into the studio with it

items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: The interviewee discusses Robert 'Barefoot' Pell in the context of a song he brought in, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with the person named 'Barefoot' other than knowing of him as the songwriter/artist.

ctx.x: I mean, not Mr. Big Stuff, Barefoot and Robert Pell. Barefoot.

Robert came in with a song. Uh, I think Euleth Gaines, I brought him in to listen to him. At that time I think he was, he was playing tennis saxophone and singing on gigs and things like that, and he came up with this song. I heard it and I said, let's try it. Uh, we went into the studio with it and it got, uh, it was on the shelf a little while.
